dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Excuse me. I'm sorry, but this isn't what I ordered.
dialogue.reading: ɪkˈskjuːz miː. aɪm ˈsɑːri, bʌt ðɪs ˈɪzənt wʌt aɪ ˈɔːrdərd.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Oh, I'm sorry. What did you order?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ, aɪm ˈsɑːri. ˈwʌt dɪd juː ˈɔːrdər?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I ordered the chicken, not the beef.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈɔːrdərd ðə ˈtʃɪkən, ˈnɑːt ðə ˈbiːf.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That's my mistake. I'll take it back and bring you the chicken.
dialogue.reading: ðæts maɪ mɪˈsteɪk. aɪl ˈteɪk ɪt ˈbæk ənd ˈbrɪŋ juː ðə ˈtʃɪkən.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Excuse me. My fish is undercooked. It's still raw inside.
dialogue.reading: ɪkˈskjuːz miː. maɪ ˈfɪʃ ɪz ˌʌndərˈkʊkt. ɪts ˈstɪl ˈrɔː ˌɪnˈsaɪd.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I'm very sorry. I'll take it back, too.
dialogue.reading: aɪm ˈvɛri ˈsɑːri. aɪl ˈteɪk ɪt ˈbæk, ˈtuː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: And these vegetables are overcooked. They're too soft.
dialogue.reading: ənd ðiːz ˈvɛdʒtəbəlz ər ˌoʊvərˈkʊkt. ðɛr ˈtuː ˈsɔːft.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I'll tell the chef. And dessert is free tonight.
dialogue.reading: aɪl ˈtɛl ðə ˈʃɛf. ənd dɪˈzɜːrt ɪz ˈfriː təˈnaɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Free dessert? That's just what we wanted!
dialogue.reading: ˈfriː dɪˈzɜːrt? ðæts ˈdʒʌst wʌt wiː ˈwɑːntɪd!
